name: Yantai Ishikawa Sealing Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Yantai Ishikawa Sealing Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive parts in China and internationally. The company provides sealing gaskets, heat insulation shields, sealing fiberboards, metal coated boards and other sealing products, and materials which are used in automobiles, generator sets, construction machinery, motorcycles, shipbuilding, general machinery, refrigeration, and petrochemicals industries. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Yantai, China.
